chunks: Surely they have greater fear of you in their hearts than of God, because they do not understand.
ai.seo_question: Why did the polytheists fear the Muslims more than God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Battle of Badr to illustrate how the polytheists' superficial knowledge (jahil) caused them to fear human retaliation more than divine retribution. This psychological insight underscores the importance of deep spiritual understanding (fiqh) in cultivating true God-consciousness (taqwa) rather than mere external bravery.
